title: K-EXAONE Technical Report Journey to Frontier-Level Performance of Foundation Models
findings: K-EXAONE demonstrated a high safety performance (96.9% Safe Rate) in the 'Social Safety' category of the KGC-SAFETY benchmark. This category explicitly includes the model's ability to handle 'religious or ideological conflicts', indicating strong performance in mitigating risks associated with these sensitive topics.
